checkpoints.name: Orient
checkpoints.purpose: Resolve tools, permissions, exact base, authority, and constraints.

checkpoints.name: Fence
checkpoints.purpose: Preserve purpose, dependencies, exclusions, falsifier, and retirement condition.

checkpoints.name: Observe
checkpoints.purpose: Inventory the bounded historical and current contract.

checkpoints.name: Admit
checkpoints.purpose: Validate observations into authority and refuse contradictions.

checkpoints.name: Plan
checkpoints.purpose: Create a deterministic manufacture and verification DAG.

checkpoints.name: Verify
checkpoints.purpose: Execute witnesses, falsifiers, schemas, and higher-order suites.

checkpoints.name: Replay
checkpoints.purpose: Repeat from clean state and compare admitted results.

checkpoints.name: Release Admission
checkpoints.purpose: Compute whether the replacement may release.

checkpoints.name: Sunset Admission
checkpoints.purpose: Compute whether a real predecessor may retire.
